title: Piscatella: US hardware market most precarious since the early 80s; Xbox YTD units -33% (all-time low), PlayStation -25% (lowest since 2013); avg prices $529 / $597 all-time highs

claims.text: 2026 YTD to Aug: Xbox units -33% (all-time low), PlayStation -25% (lowest since 2013)
Avg price paid: Xbox $529 (+26%), PlayStation $597 (+20%), all-time US highs
"not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s"; GTA VI may ease declines depending on availability and pricing

why: Follow-up to the August numbers; the analysis card while the topic is live

dxb.x: Record prices, record lows. Circana's Mat Piscatella on where US console sales stand going into GTA VI.
